description: Gryphon playground — the muck-around flavor. A shippable, in-package boot RECORD (rides the gryphon_playground wheel/git artifact at tap_plugin/gryphon_playground/boot/, per req-boot-bootstrap-records-in-package) that stands up the closest-to-minimal TAP instance: just the neutral grid_fixtures__* node/edge vocabulary and the gryphon_playground Gridkin corpus/harness that depends_on it, existing only to exercise the Gryphon query language and nothing else. No admin chrome, no seeded data, no collectors: the grid comes up empty and reaches out to nothing, and the Gridkin corpus builds its scenarios at query/test time rather than seeding population (hence an empty population section). The web UI and API surfaces still mount (auth/login is the only web chrome), because a truly headless boot is not yet supported (backlog: tap_web req-web-rendering-headless; tap_api headless-API disable). Install sources are GIT (the shippable-record class travels to deployments and pulls its plugins from their own repos); both repos are PUBLIC, so neither source declares a `credential` — a record that names one makes it MANDATORY on every host that boots it (req-tap-plugin-arch-source-secret-5), which is a cost to impose only where a repo is actually private. A repo-local editable harness profile serves monorepo dev. Selected by pointer `<source-ref>#playground`.
